pr_title: Reduce word counts, add anti-echoing, and guide lever_id extraction
pr_description: Reduced word counts**: description 80-100→50-70, synergy/conflict 40-60→20-40. Helps gpt-oss-20b complete within 600s. Anti-echoing** (positive framing): "Add new insight beyond what consequences and review already state" lever_id field description**: "The hexadecimal uuid of the lever, without XML tags" System prompt XML guidance**: Explains that lever IDs are wrapped in `<lever>uuid</lever>` tags and to return only the hexadecimal uuid inside Supersedes #467 which had the word count/anti-echo changes but lacked the XML-tag extraction guidance, causing llama3.1 to return `<lever>uuid</lever>` as lever_id.
